missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Морда' is feminine nominative as the subject. 'Добрая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'у собаки' shows whose muzzle it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Морду' is the feminine accusative object of 'спрятал'. 'В лапы' is the accusative direction phrase showing where it hid.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На морде' uses the prepositional ending after 'на' to locate the spot. 'Белое пятно' is the nominative subject of the sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Морды' is the genitive after 'нет' in this playful statement. 'Этой лошади' is the genitive frame showing whose.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'С морды' takes the genitive after 'с' to show snow falling off the muzzle. 'Медведя' is genitive meaning of the bear.

missions.phrase: Я смотрю собаке прямо в морду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В морду' uses the accusative after 'в' to show looking into the muzzle. 'Собаке' is the dative complement of 'смотрю'.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К морде' uses the dative after 'к' to mean against the muzzle. 'Трава' is the nominative subject that stuck.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Перед мордой' uses the instrumental after 'перед' to mean in front of the muzzle. 'Кость' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Мордочки' is the nominative plural diminutive as the subject. 'Смешные' agrees, and 'у щенков' shows whose little faces.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Морд' is the genitive plural required after 'несколько'. 'Собачьих' agrees, and 'на фото' gives the place.
